semantic.justification: Transfers bounded native character text effects and the optional document pool override between the background filter and the editor. Restores the same UNO tree and accepts earlier documents without this override. Transports the original string-valued theme font members of the character interoperability bag. Transfers original typed styleSet children through the current Worker alongside earlier compact scalar snapshots. The Word 2010 effect roots for glow, shadow, reflection, scene3d and props3d now use the original generated definitions and nested interoperability properties for DOCX run and style persistence through the browser Worker.
